description: Make the voice for script lines with ElevenLabs, with the time of every word, and give it to the shots that speak each line (captions follow the words; shots fit the voice unless fit is false). Spends the person's ElevenLabs characters: the first call (without confirm) returns the cost and what's left; ask, then call again with confirm: true. Default: every line without a voice, in the film's voice. Returns what was made and characters left. For the person's own recording (free), use own_voice.

again.description: Make the voice again even for lines that have one.

confirm.description: true only after the person agreed to the cost.

fit.description: Shots get the voice's length (default true).

lines.description: Line ids from script with action get. Default: every line without a voice.

model.description: Default eleven_multilingual_v2. Flash and turbo cost half.

voice.description: An ElevenLabs voice id (voices). Default: the film's voice.

name: speak
